description: Short real-run smoke for 36_franca (Franca self-supervised ViT). This is the EVAL_DOWNLOAD eval-only shape (docs/EVAL_DOWNLOAD.md): the capture's 'Step 1' is a linear probe on the official pretrained Franca ViT-B/14 In21K backbone (a genuine SSL representation, so the number is comparable, analogous to DINOv2), and the from-scratch SSL pretraining is the excluded Step 2, so this port has no runnable step 1 and its real-run smoke is a single linear_eval stage that reads a frozen backbone and produces no encoder.pt. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3); the spec lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. Like 28_dinov2, the architecture is fixed by the named builder (franca_vitb14, the smallest, embed_dim 768) rather than by config dims, so only the run-length and resolution knobs are overridden: resolution 518 -> 28 (a 2x2 patch14 grid), the tiny backbone the method's own test (tests/test_method_36_franca.py) exercises on CPU. The official checkpoint is a pinned sha256 download (bin/fetch-weights.py); the hermetic smoke leaves FRANCA_CKPT empty so the backbone is built pretrained=False (random), exercising the pipeline while downloading nothing (its accuracy is meaningless by design). embed_dim/depth/patch_size are fixed by the named builder and are not config keys here.
